description: This file defines the 'Gateway' class responsible for managing client connections, message routing, connection lifecycle, and gateway maintenance tasks within the Orleans runtime. It includes nested classes for client state management and reply routing cache, and uses logging for operational insights.

classes.name: Gateway
classes.description: Main class managing client connections, message delivery, routing, and maintenance within the Orleans runtime. Implements interface IConnectedClientCollection.

classes.name: Gateway.ClientState
classes.description: Tracks individual client connection state, message queue, and connection lifecycle management.

classes.name: Gateway.ClientsReplyRoutingCache
classes.description: Caches routing information for replies from client addressable objects to optimize message routing back to clients.

methods.name: GetClientActivationAddress
methods.description: Generates a deterministic activation address for a client given its GrainId and silo address.

methods.name: PerformGatewayMaintenance
methods.description: Periodically performs maintenance tasks such as dropping disconnected clients and expiring routing cache entries.

methods.name: SendStopSendMessages
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down message sending to all connected clients.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the gateway, cancels maintenance timer, and waits for ongoing maintenance task completion.

methods.name: TryToReroute
methods.description: Determines the appropriate silo address to route a message, considering system targets and reply routing cache.

methods.name: DropExpiredRoutingCachedEntries
methods.description: Removes stale entries from the reply routing cache.

methods.name: RecordOpenedConnection
methods.description: Records a new connection for a given client, updating internal collections and version.

methods.name: RecordClosedConnection
methods.description: Removes a connection record and updates internal state when a connection is closed.

methods.name: DropDisconnectedClients
methods.description: Identifies and drops clients that have been disconnected long enough without reconnecting.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Handles message delivery to proxy clients if applicable, and manages reply routing updates.
